CRPF suspends DIG over social media posts opposing CAPF bill

A Deputy Inspector General (DIG)-rank officer in the Central Reserve Police Force (CRPF) has been suspended for allegedly sharing messages on social media that opposed the Centre's new CAPF bill. The suspension comes after the officer's family reportedly protested against the bill. Some reports also mention the transfer of 20 other officers in connection with the incident.
